```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Librarias 
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #

library(tsibble)
library(lubridate)      # ymd()
library(dplyr)          # mutate()
library(feasts)         # para plots
library(fabletools)     # para test dickey 
library(ggplot2)
library(fable)          # para ajustar modelos
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
#library(ggpubr)
```




```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# cargo la y
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

dy <- readxl::read_excel("agbarometer_ARG_imputado.xlsx") |> 
  mutate(Bimestre = yearmonth(Bimestre)) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = Bimestre) |> 
#  select(`Ag Barometer`, Bimestre) |> 
  mutate(fecha = Bimestre, .keep = "unused") |> 
  relocate(fecha)
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# cargo las x (mensuales). Les elimino filas para q tenga igual period q AgB
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

# 1. solo me quedo con meses pares (para poder hacer correls con las x un perioso atras)
# 2. si AgB va de Nov2018-Ene2026 --> las x van de Oct2018-Dic2025

dx <- readxl::read_excel("Covariables.xlsx", sheet = "Monthly Prices") |> 
  mutate(fecha = yearmonth(lubridate::ym(fecha1)), .keep ="unused") |> 
  relocate(fecha) |> 
  select(-fecha2, -`ICC Michigan`) |> 
  filter(fecha >= yearmonth("2018-10"),
         fecha <= yearmonth("2026-01")) |>    #, month(fecha) %% 2 == 0) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = fecha)
```


```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# uno la y con las x
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- 

# El d resultante va a tener 20 cols
# x : d[ , 3:ncol]
# y : col 2 de d


d <- dy |> 
  select(fecha, `Ag Barometer`) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  full_join(dx |> as_tibble(), by = "fecha") |> 
  arrange(fecha) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = fecha) |> 
  mutate(across(2:ncol(dx), as.numeric))
```

## AgB(t) vs covariables(t)


```{r}
# x : d[ , 3:ncol(d)]
# y : col 2 de d

# saco los filas con NA de AgB
d_sin_NA <- d |> filter(!is.na(`Ag Barometer`))|> 
  mutate(across(2:ncol(d), as.numeric))

cors <- cor(d_sin_NA[, 3:ncol(d_sin_NA)], 
            d_sin_NA[["Ag Barometer"]], 
            use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
            method = "pearson")

df_cor <- tibble(
  variable = rownames(cors),
  r        = cors[, 1],
  p = purrr::map_dbl(
    rownames(cors), ~ cor.test(d[[.x]], 
                               d[["Ag Barometer"]],
                               method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
) |> 
  arrange(r) |>
  mutate(
    p_label   = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p, 3))),
    variable  = factor(variable, levels = variable)
  )

df_cor$variable <- factor(df_cor$variable, levels = df_cor$variable)
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

# Gráfico de barras: t vs t
ggplot(df_cor, aes(x = r, y = variable, fill = r > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2),
                hjust = ifelse(r > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
            size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2980b9", "FALSE" = "#c0392b"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "r de Pearson", 
       y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```



```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
## Scatter AgB(t) vs covariables(t)

d |>
  select(fecha, `Ag Barometer`, 3:ncol(d)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(fecha, `Ag Barometer`),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") |>
  left_join(df_cor |> select(variable, r, p_label), 
            by = "variable") |>
  mutate(label = paste0(variable, "\nr = ", round(r, 2)),
         label = reorder(label, -r)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = valor, y = `Ag Barometer`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Ag Barometer (t) vs covariables (t)",
       x = NULL, 
       y = "Ag Barometer",
       caption = "r: coeficiente de correlación de Pearson") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
```


## AgB(t) vs covariables(t-1)

```{r}
# 1. muevo las x una fila abajo --> agbarometer marzo vs x febrero
d_lag <- d |>
  mutate(across(3:ncol(d), \(x) lag(x, 1)))  # todas las X pasan a ser X(t-1)

# 2. saco las filas con NA
d_sin_NA <- d_lag |> filter(!is.na(`Ag Barometer`))

cors <- cor(d_sin_NA[, 3:ncol(d_sin_NA)], 
            d_sin_NA[["Ag Barometer"]], 
            use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
            method = "pearson")

df_cor <- tibble(
  variable = rownames(cors),
  r        = cors[, 1],
  p = purrr::map_dbl(
    rownames(cors), ~ cor.test(d[[.x]], 
                               d[["Ag Barometer"]],
                               method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
) |> 
  arrange(r) |>
  mutate(
    p_label   = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p, 3))),
    variable  = factor(variable, levels = variable)
  )

df_cor$variable <- factor(df_cor$variable, levels = df_cor$variable)
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

# Gráfico de barras: t vs t-1
ggplot(df_cor, aes(x = r, y = variable, fill = r > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2),
                hjust = ifelse(r > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
            size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2980b9", "FALSE" = "#c0392b"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "r de Pearson", 
       y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
```
